description: Resume collection for a paused item. The result's collection field says what will collect it: monitor or subscription (collected from the next scheduled run), or manual (only on request). Items whose platform cannot collect in their region (TikTok in CN or HK) stay paused and return UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_REGION; report that reason rather than retrying.
